tools.name: search_email
tools.description: Search live Gmail with standard Gmail query syntax; never falls back to local cache. Use for any inbox-wide claim. Local workflow filters is:todo, is:done, is:snoozed are supported with AND only. Default fields ONLY: date, participants, subject, bodySnippet (+ THREAD_REF). Never returns bodyFull — call read_email for full body. Each call returns at most 20 hits; repeated searches are allowed. If Gmail fails, explain the failure to the user and try another non-cache approach.

parameters.name: about
parameters.description: Gmail query keywords/fields, e.g. newer_than:7d from:alice.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Additional Gmail or local workflow filter, e.g. is:important AND is:todo.

parameters.name: todo_message_ids
parameters.description: Copy ui_context ids when using is:todo.

parameters.name: done_message_ids
parameters.description: Copy ui_context ids when using is:done.

parameters.name: snoozed_message_ids
parameters.description: Copy ui_context ids when using is:snoozed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max hits this call (default 12, hard cap 20).

parameters.name: readMask
parameters.description: Optional subset of date,participants,subject,bodySnippet. bodyFull is rejected; use read_email.

tools.name: read_email
tools.description: Read ONE searched email by thread_ref. Default readMask: date, participants, subject, bodySnippet. Request bodyFull ONLY when snippet is insufficient for the answer.
